name: MKT_IMP_OBJECT_ATTRS
description: This stores all the attributes in the VO corresponding to the import object detail.

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_ID
columns.description: Object Attribute Id - Primary key of this table.

columns.name: USERKEY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this attribute is a userkey or not

columns.name: STANDARD_OBJECT_ATTR_COL
columns.description: Used to save the column mismatch for PSC related object related to PK or any other column

columns.name: STANDARD_OBJECT_ATTR_TABLE
columns.description: Used to save the new Partitioned interface table

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Object Detail Id - Foreign key to MKT_IMP_OBJECT_DETAILS

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_COL
columns.description: Object Attribute Column Name which refers to the column name in the interface table

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Object Attribute Name refers to the attribute name in the interface vo

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: Object Attribute Type refers to the datatype of the attribute

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_LEN
columns.description: Object Attribute Length refers to the length of the attribute

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_DEFAULT
columns.description: Object Attribute Default value in the VO

columns.name: MAPPABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this attribute is mappable from file import UI

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_TABLE
columns.description: Object Attribute Table Name refers to the name of the interface table

columns.name: MANDATORY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this attribute is mandatory from import wizard

columns.name: OBJECT_ATTR_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate Key for object attributes

columns.name: DISPLAY_VALUE
columns.description: Display value of the attribute from file import UI

columns.name: COLUMN_HEADER_NAME
columns.description: Column Header Name to store the name of the column from csv to the corrosponding view attrbute. It will be used for the auto mapping.

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Transaction VO Attribute Name corresponding to the interface VO Attribute

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_COL
columns.description: The column saves the column name of the base table for the corresponding TXN_VO_ATTR_NAME

columns.name: TXN_VO_ATTR_TABLE
columns.description: The column saves the value of the base table name

columns.name: MD_UPDATABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Column holds the value regarding whether the attribute is updatable or not. Value 1 indicates attribute is updatable and 0 indicates its not updatable

columns.name: MD_DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: Column holds the default value of all the attributes

columns.name: MD_ATTR_TYPE
columns.description: Column holds the type of the custom attribute added to any object

columns.name: MD_ATTR_MIN_LENGTH
columns.description: Column used to hold the minimum length for Custom Text Attributes

columns.name: MD_ATTR_MAX_VALUE
columns.description: Column used to hold the Max value property of the custom number field

columns.name: MD_ATTR_MIN_VALUE
columns.description: Column used to hold the Min value property of the custom number field

columns.name: MD_ATTR_DECIMAL_VALUE
columns.description: Column used to hold the scale for custom number and percentage fields

columns.name: MD_ATTR_FCL_LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Column used to hold the value of LOOKUP_TYPE for custom Fixed Choice fields

columns.name: MD_ATTR_DCL_BASE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Column used to hold the base table of the custom Dynamic choice list field

columns.name: MD_ATTR_DCL_BASE_TABLE_PK1
columns.description: Primary Key column name of DCL source attribute

columns.name: MD_ATTR_DCL_BASE_TABLE_PK2
columns.description: Primary Key column name of DCL source attribute

columns.name: MD_ATTR_DCL_BASE_CATEGORY
columns.description: To hold the attribute category of the object if the DCL is based on custom object record

columns.name: MD_USER_KEY1
columns.description: Column used to hold the user key column used to resolve the DCL attribute values

columns.name: MD_USER_KEY2
columns.description: Column used to hold the user key column used to resolve the DCL attribute values

columns.name: MD_USER_KEY3
columns.description: Column used to hold the user key column used to resolve the DCL attribute values

columns.name: MD_USER_KEY4
columns.description: Column used to hold the user key column used to resolve the DCL attribute values

columns.name: MD_ALTERNATE_KEY1
columns.description: Reserved column to save the alternate key values

columns.name: MD_ALTERNATE_KEY2
columns.description: Reserved column to save the alternate key values

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
